en.headline: Your blood thinner and your food
body: Your blood thinner is called warfarin.
Green leafy food changes how well it works.
Keep the same amount of greens each week.
Tell your doctor before any new tablet or herb.
en.passage: keep their intake consistent from week to week so that the INR stays stable

ms.headline: Ubat pencair darah dan makanan anda
body: Ubat pencair darah anda dipanggil warfarin.
Sayur hijau mengubah cara ia bekerja.
Makan jumlah sayur hijau yang sama setiap minggu.
Beritahu doktor anda sebelum ambil ubat atau herba baru.
ms.passage: keep their intake consistent from week to week so that the INR stays stable

zh.headline: 您的抗凝血药和您的食物
body: 您的抗凝血药叫华法林。
绿叶菜会改变它的效果。
每周吃差不多一样多的绿叶菜。
吃任何新的药或草药之前，先告诉您的医生。
zh.passage: keep their intake consistent from week to week so that the INR stays stable
